comments.text: Imagine planning your entire day around a road that the ocean erases twice. For just 150 people, the tide isn’t scenery—it controls everyday life. 🌊

comments.text: Slapping luxury skyscrapers and mega-projects everywhere doesn't change how extreme the summer heat and rigid social rules actually are. Living here daily is way different than what shiny promo videos show.

comments.text: If you ignore clear tide warnings and get trapped in the 'idiot box' at [00:53], you should be billed every single penny for the Coastguard rescue and helicopter fuel.
